invariants.rationale: Parallelism is often required to be positive for parallel operations in Java streaming contexts.
Input data must be non-null to safely invoke data.stream() in the method body.
Consumer must not be null to safely execute foreach with the provided consumer.
Parallelism should not exceed the size of the data unless data is empty.
Parallelism should not be greater than Integer.MAX_VALUE, due to Java int constraints.
